Icy conditions have been present at many USGS streamflow gages in the Potomac watershed at times during the past week, including at Point of Rocks, Maryland. When ice is present at a stream gage, mean daily flow values are often not made available by the USGS because stream stage values can no longer be used to accurately and automatically compute streamflow. Yesterday's Point of Rocks mean daily flow value in today’s drought report, below, were computed by CO-OP staff from available real-time data and are only provisional estimates.
